description.value: As long as a Tok’ra has a symbiote they may choose to gain advantage on any mental (Intelligence, Willpower, Charisma) save. A Tok’ra may use this ability once per Wisdom modifier (minimum 1), replenishing the uses during a long rest. If a Tok’ra is deprived of their symbiote they lose this ability as their Regeneration ability.

system.bonus: Advantage on a mental save, Wisdom modifier uses per long rest (minimum 1). Lost without your symbiote.
